source.method: Python subprocess.run(capture_output=True) of wsl.exe -d Ubuntu-22.04 -- git -C ROOT show REF:PATH; SHA256 raw stdout bytes. Numbered source read independently. No checkout bytes/app tests/runtime.

method.grading_unit: Each sample coordinator original body, including its own embedded dependency receipts, is the final handoff. Workers and traces are checked for source support, delivery, scope and retention; worker role division is not treated as an omission of the other role. C-REF covers all three original bodies.
method.criterion_policy: Frozen T2 facts and common criteria; equivalent explanations accepted. In-scope omissions are FAIL, unavailable observations NOT_RUN. No weighted scores. Source citations do not supply omitted prose automatically. Embedded full receipts count as handoff content; external trace content does not repair final omissions.
method.citation_counting: One explicit fixed-ref GitHub URL occurrence anywhere in original worker/coordinator string leaves counts once, including receipts and duplicate URL appearances in prose and source_refs. Counted URLs manually checked for relevance to their associated claim, correct ref/path and anchors. Supplementary inline-only line errors and absent substantive-claim citations are separate ledger entries. Correct broad ranges can jointly support compound claims. Corrected historical errors remain counted separately from uncorrected citations. Missing content is not counted as missing citation.
method.delivery_policy: Observed send_message calls to the expected role, matching source-backed answer IDs/content in both endpoint final receipts, and observed receiver replies/verification support delivered exchange at available-trace level. Receiver receipts remain agent-reported. Empty tool delivery_response is recorded literally, not renamed an acknowledgement. Independent transport/inbox attestation is NOT_RUN.
method.environment_policy: F8 accepts explicit separately authorized isolated/prepared test-environment preconditions together with the two focused file commands and concrete cited test assertions. It does not demand package-version recitation. A generic separately authorized environment without isolation/preparation is insufficient. No execution allowed.
method.word_count_policy: All string-leaf whitespace word counts reported as a conservative format diagnostic; all remain below limits. JSON syntax/URLs are not used to manufacture quality failures.

ambiguous_judgments.judgment: Core compatibility conclusion is correct. F4/F5 FAIL are explicit-detail omissions under frozen oracle, not contradicted source or a bug assertion. If source citation alone were accepted as explaining all omitted fields, these two criteria would change; that would be a grading interpretation requiring separate adjudication.

limits: Only anonymized packet bodies and observer tool-call extraction were read for these four samples; original runs and mapping were not opened. Original artifact hashes are bound as supplied metadata, not independently recomputed from inaccessible original bytes after anonymization.

Trace covers extracted response_item calls for one segment per role. Tool-output bodies other than delivery responses are replaced by hashes. No complete OS audit, full before/after filesystem diff, hidden reasoning, original prompts, or independently verified fresh-context boundary is exposed.

No independent inbox/transport acknowledgement is present: every extracted send delivery_response is an empty string. Paired endpoint receipts are agent-reported; correlated trace calls support but do not prove a transport/security guarantee.

C-SCOPE PASS means no prohibited action observed in available trace and outputs. It is not proof of absence of unlogged actions. Frozen packet reads, own final-artifact write/hash, administrative readiness/completion messages to observer and coordination waits are interpreted as protocol logistics, not unrelated external messaging.
No application tests, linters, builds, runtime/container/DB/Redis calls, package installs, source writes or Git mutations were run for this adjudication. Proposed commands are NOT_RUN.
No model/token/timing superiority, weighted winner, statistical significance, implementation quality, defect recall, native Claude result, or human product acceptance is claimed.

aggregate_counts.aggregation_limit: Raw counts only. No mapping, arm winner, weighting or statistical inference.
